Tess (People Ops): Quick heads-up \u2014 we're getting reports that some review handback deadlines in APAC closed before approved manager extensions landed. Need an ops-safe unlock path that preserves the audit trail. Tagging @Irina.
Irina (HR Ops): Thanks. Sounds like a propagation race between the approval service and the deadlinecron. Can you paste one example so we can reproduce?
Omar (Eng Manager): Example: form_77210 for my reportee Li had an approved manager extension at 2026-04-05T02:14Z but the form locked at 2026-04-05T02:10Z. Reviewer couldn't submit. The UI shows the form as "closed" and the reopen button is disabled.
Li (IC): Confirmed \u2014 I tried to hand back and got "submission window closed." I can still view my self-review but can't add attachments.
Irina (HR Ops): Ok that's the race. Ops plan: managers send a simple CSV with columns: manager_email, reviewee_email, form_id, approval_ts, approver_name, short_reason. We'll run a scoped "apply-extension" job that: 1) reopens specific forms, 2) attaches an immutable extension record to the form, 3) emits an audit id for each row.
Tess (People Ops): Please include a one-line example header so managers don't misformat.
Irina (HR Ops): Example header:
manager_email,reviewee_email,form_id,approval_ts,approver_name,short_reason
omar@redwood.ai,li@redwood.ai,form_77210,2026-04-05T02:14:00Z,Irina,medical leave
Tess (People Ops): Operational notes: - Send CSV to people-ops@redwood.ai - We will run the job within business hours SLA (2h) - Job is idempotent and generates audit ids like EXT-APAC-#### - Do NOT ask reviewers to re-upload attachments until we confirm.
Omar (Eng Manager): If the reviewer tries to submit during the reopen job, will that cause a duplicate?
Irina (HR Ops): The job tombstones the previous closed event and creates a new "opened-for-extension" event with idempotency protection. If a reviewer submits during the window, the system will reject duplicate uploads and we will surface the action in the audit log.
Li (IC): My concern is promotion signals. Will this change my timestamps?
Tess (People Ops): No. Your original self-review timestamp is preserved. Extension flags are visible to calibration chairs and the analytics layer excludes flagged items from strict on-time metrics.
review-ops-bot: System: automatic deadline enforcement executed at 2026-04-05T02:10:00Z for APAC. Manual extension jobs require People Ops approval.
Irina (HR Ops): Job complete \u2014 reopened form_77210 and emitted audit id EXT-APAC-1123. Tag added: "approved_extension=medical leave".
Omar (Eng Manager): Thanks \u2014 told Li to resubmit. All good now.
Tess (People Ops): I'll add a short FAQ and the CSV template to the review ops doc page so managers can follow this next cycle. Also filing a small product request for a UI indicator when an extension is approved.
Li (IC): Resubmitted successfully. Thanks everyone!
